retired.//arbiter: NOT a global role. There is no arbiter() to call: the arbiter is a per-escrow field of the Escrow struct, set at createEscrow and changeable only by the V2 setArbiter(uint256,address). The address below is the arbiter of record rotated into the nine disputed v1 escrows listed under arbiterRotations — it never had authority over the deployment as a whole.

upgrades.reason: PF-S124. PF-S123 added natspec to EscrowUpgradeable, which changes no storage layout and no behaviour, so the proxy was UPGRADED rather than replaced. upgradeToAndCall was called with EMPTY calldata: there is no reinitializer to run and passing one would be a state write dressed up as an upgrade. Rehearsed first on throwaway contracts via script/RecoveryDrill.s.sol, which passed on Base Sepolia. Read back after: implementation slot holds the new address, nextEscrowId still 14, owner and verifier unchanged, escrow 0 still Released and escrow 1 still Resolved.
